text: Implemented renderer-neutral adaptive fitting with constant logical-pixel insets and explicit SinglePlane presentation. Physical aspect, named plane state and cursor persist; hidden planes skip sampling/drawing/picks and visiblePanels/visibleReadouts serve host presentation. Independent packing oracle + focus/state/pointer regressions pass on JVM35 and JS35; JavaFX2, Java2D2, Canvas5 consumer checks pass (79 total). Exact sources, native HEAD ce95fb5649ff1fe51ba627bcfe23bbef6a621f7b, complete log and limitations retained in docs/verification/adaptive-orthogonal-layout-2026-09-09/receipt.json and guide docs/image-viewer.md. Changes remain uncommitted local candidate. PLS Neuro exact four-path delta was adopted at fd992a0c + patch6f2697b6 and its desktop/real beta+FIR native probes compile/run the API. Independent consumer review caught an application Canvas clear-on-publication bug, now owned and being fixed in ResultVolumeView; this is not provider fitting failure. App selector/persistence/framebuffer/native visual acceptance remains open in consumer bd-01M23RG0ED4BXVPT9KT18R135Y. Optimization is bounded to L/row/column; no arbitrary packing or final product certification claimed.
